brandingSaveFailed: Platform configuration could not be saved
imSaveFailed: The notification configuration could not be saved
logoUploadFailed: The logo could not be uploaded
brandingHint: Only platform administrators can change platform configuration. Saving a deployment domain immediately updates public URLs such as the MCP endpoint and Executor startup commands. Without a domain, the deployment environment URL is used.
domainHint: Enter the URL users visit for this deployment, for example https://wonder.example.com. Saving it immediately updates public URLs such as the MCP endpoint and Executor startup commands.
logoTooLarge: Logo files must not exceed 512 KB
logoHint: PNG, JPG/JPEG, WebP, SVG, GIF, ICO and AVIF are supported, up to 512 KB.
accentHint: The accent colour affects primary buttons, links, selected items and focus hints only; page backgrounds and success/warning/error colours stay as they are.
primaryColorHint: Click the swatches above for more colours and set a custom platform accent. Remember to click “Save configuration” for it to take effect.
imLoadFailed: Failed to load collaboration notification configuration
providerHint: The system picks between Lark and DingTalk; project notifications and personal IM accounts follow this setting.
channelHint: Once you switch and save, the previous channel stops sending notifications.
keepSecretHint: Saving with it blank keeps the configured AppSecret
keepSecret: Leave blank to keep the current secret
groupChatSectionHint: For binding group chats to spaces and talking to AI members there.
currentChannelHint: Notification delivery and group-chat access for every space follow this setting.
switchChannelBody: This setting drives both system notifications and group-chat access for every space. After switching, the previous channel stops taking new messages while accepted ones finish out; existing bindings and configuration are kept and come back when you switch back.
switchChannelDirty: You have unsaved changes. Save or explicitly discard them before switching.
imSelectionSaveFailed: The collaboration channel could not be switched
imSwitchHint: After switching, the previous channel stops taking new messages while accepted ones finish out; shared group-chat bindings can only be added under the current channel.
groupChatSaveFailed: The group-chat bot configuration could not be saved
groupChatLoadFailed: Failed to load group-chat bot configuration
groupChatStatusHint: This is the state the platform configuration permits. It does not mean every group is bound and usable, nor that every message is processed or delivered successfully.
groupChatSetupHint: Once the platform's shared {{provider}} group-chat bot is configured, a space admin only needs the group ID and the AI member to create a binding.
groupChatDescription: The shared bot uses platform-level app credentials; the notification bot and the group-chat bot must be separate app identities.
enableGroupChat: Turn on the shared group-chat bot
enableGroupChatAria: Turn on the shared {{provider}} group-chat bot
keepToken: Leave it blank to keep the existing Token
tokenHelp: Get it from the Lark app under “Events & callbacks → Encryption strategy”
keepEncryption: Encryption is configured; leave blank to keep the existing key
encryptionHelp: Optional — leaving it blank keeps the Lark encryption policy
clearEncryption: Clear Encrypt Key (also disable encryption in Feishu)
adminPermission: Only platform administrators can perform this action
adminAddFailed: Could not add the platform administrator
adminRemoveFailed: Could not remove the platform administrator
adminHint: Platform administrators manage platform configuration, collaboration notifications and every project (including the recycle bin). They cannot remove themselves, and at least one must remain.
searchHint: Search by name, username or email
clearUser: Clear the selected user and the search text
selfRemoval: You cannot remove yourself as a platform administrator
lastAdmin: At least one platform administrator must remain
ssoHint: Maintain identity providers (IdPs) and sign-in connections here. The sign-in page lists only entries whose connection and owning IdP are both enabled, in the order they were added.
ssoIdpDescriptionPlaceholder: Optional — describe what this IdP is for
ssoDisableIdpImpact: The {{connections}} sign-in connections under this IdP will disappear from the sign-in page; nothing already configured is deleted.
ssoConnectionHint: Each connection is one sign-in entry and can be enabled or disabled on its own. The protocol and its owning IdP are fixed once created.
ssoProtocolLockedHint: The owning IdP and protocol cannot be changed after creation.
ssoSamlCallbackHint: Configure this ACS URL as the assertion consumer service on the IdP, and make the IdP return RelayState unchanged.
ssoOidcCallbackHint: Configure this URL as the redirect URI of the OIDC application.
ssoCallbackDeployHint: The URL uses the configured deployment domain, falling back to the platform public address or the current origin. Update the IdP configuration after changing the domain.
ssoClientSecretKeepHint: A secret is configured. Leave blank to keep the current secret.
ssoClientSecretPlaceholder: Leave blank to keep the current secret
ssoAttributeHint: Optional — leave blank to use the protocol's default claims.
ssoAllowedTenantsHint: Optional. Separate multiple values with commas; leave blank for no restriction.
ssoNewConnectionDisabledHint: New connections start disabled — switch them on once the configuration checks out.
ssoConnectionSaveFailed: The sign-in connection could not be saved
ssoLoadFailed: Failed to load enterprise SSO configuration
ssoPreviewHint: These are the entries the sign-in page shows right now, in the order they were added.
ssoPreviewEmpty: No login methods to show. Enable a connection and its parent IdP.
ssoPreviewOnly: This is a preview only. Start signing in from the login page.
ssoOverviewHint: SSO sign-in methods are maintained by platform administrators. You can view this overview only and cannot change the configuration.
groupChatIdentityEditable: Configured; the application identity can be changed
groupChatNewIdentitySecretHint: Changing the application requires the new application's App Secret
groupChatNewIdentityTokenHint: After switching apps, fill in the new app's Verification Token
groupChatIdentityChangeTitle: The group-chat bot application identity will change
groupChatIdentityChangeImpact: Saving affects every shared-group binding on this channel, and replies the old app has not sent yet stop; add the new bot to the target groups first. Whether the app credentials really work shows up in the connection status after saving.
